title: Thinking on the Creative Process
summary: Kahran and Divya circle the creative process from many angles — when to switch formats versus stay consistent for an audience, the role of self-indulgent play in creative work, how each story has an ideal medium (and how mastering a new medium opens new stories), and why people enjoy watching other people play games. Jhumpa Lahiri writing in Italian is a recurring touchstone.

intents.display: to think about the creative process and when to shift your form
